lines.text: [whispering, close to the mic, intimate, telling a secret] Every night at eleven eleven... a stranger sends me a voice message.
lines.show: Every night at 11:11… a stranger sends me a voice message.

lines.text: [quiet, unsettled] And everything he says comes true.
[warm, a little out of breath, amused] Hey. Don't freak out. Tomorrow at eight-oh-two, you'll spill your coffee. [softer, a smile in his voice] Wear the blue dress anyway.
lines.show: Hey. Don't freak out. Tomorrow at 8:02, you'll spill your coffee. Wear the blue dress anyway.

lines.text: [dry, dismissive, then shaken] I deleted it. [beat] At eight-oh-two... I spilled my coffee.
lines.show: I deleted it. At 8:02… I spilled my coffee.

lines.text: [serious, careful, quiet] The guy on the train will ask your name. Lie.
[tense, quick] He asked. I lied. My hands wouldn't stop shaking.
[urgent, low, trying to stay calm] Mira. Tomorrow, six-forty, Fifth Street. Stay on the curb. Promise me.
lines.show: Mira. Tomorrow, 6:40, Fifth Street. Stay on the curb. Promise me.

lines.text: [fast, breathless, adrenaline] Six-forty. A car ran the red light... and someone pulled me back.
lines.show: 6:40. A car ran the red light… and someone pulled me back.

lines.text: [breathless, awed, slowing down] Dark eyes. A watch stopped at eleven eleven.
lines.show: Dark eyes. A watch stopped at 11:11.

lines.text: [whisper, stunned] It was his voice. The one from my phone.
[puzzled, a polite half-smile] Sorry... have we met?
[hurt, quiet] He had no idea who I was.
[low, dread] That night... one last message.
[voice breaking, close to the phone, barely holding it together] If you've met me... I'm sorry. Don't fall in love with me.
[a broken whisper, final] In seven days... I don't make it.
